title: the_humvee_i_signed_for
display_title: I reported a $180,000 Humvee stolen — I was the one who hid it
beats: I signed for a Humvee that vanished from our motor pool for six days, and I knew exactly where it was the entire time.
I (24M) parked it behind an abandoned equipment shed off-post after a night I'd rather forget, and panicked when I couldn't remember driving it there.
Instead of confessing, I reported it stolen and let CID open an investigation, watched them question three of my friends.
One almost got charged with larceny of government property before I finally cracked and showed them where it was.
I told them I'd just 'found' it that morning, and somehow they believed me over the timeline that didn't add up.
I still have the Article 15 memo in a drawer, and the guy who almost got charged still texts me happy birthday every year.
